name: commit-combobox
title: Commit Combobox
description: Unpicked text is matched on blur (an exact match is picked, a misspelling gets a Did you mean, duplicate names ask which), editing after a pick visibly drops it with Undo or Esc, and the stored option is always read back.

meta.stops: Typed text saved instead of a pick
meta.summary: A pick-from-list field that never saves text the user only typed, and visibly drops a pick when it is typed over.
catches: Typed text left without a pick when leaving the field
Misspellings, with a one-tap Did you mean
Two options with the same name, by asking which
A pick silently replaced by later typing
limits: Fuzzy matching is for suggestions only; it never picks a near match on its own
With loadOptions, matching only covers the options returned
a11y: role="combobox" with aria-autocomplete="list", aria-expanded, aria-controls and aria-activedescendant
Arrow keys move through options, Enter picks, Escape closes or undoes
